M1.reason: Against the brief's pump shotgun: a long slim barrel, a receiver block, a wooden grooved pump under the barrel, and a wooden stock with an angled butt. The outline reads as a pump shotgun in the left, top and below views. No part sticks out or is missing.

M2.reason: Long axis measures 30.2 against the brief's 30, an offset of 0.6%, well inside 15%. The measured width (1.7) and height (13.3) are not asked for by the brief.

M3.reason: Parts the brief implies, checked one by one: barrel (present), receiver with ejection port (present, dark square in the below view), pump (present, wood with grooves), stock and butt plate (present, angled in the below and top views), trigger guard (present, a loop under the receiver in the left and below views). Not confirmed at this scale: a magazine tube along the barrel and a front bead sight. Their absence cannot be ruled out, so M3 stays at 1. The marbled streaks on the receiver are paint, not a part, and are charged to M4 and M5.

M4.reason: The brief asks for black metal with a wood or dark pump and stock. The stock and pump are a plausible wood brown and the barrel is dark. The receiver flank shows grey-white marbled streaks in the right, front-right and back-right views, and the p_ model's lower receiver shows the same light streaking. That is not the black metal the brief asks for.

M5.reason: Nothing in the brief asks for surface detail, so this is judged on what is added. The light marbled bands on the receiver flank (right, front-right, back-right views; lower grip in the in-hand view) look like a texture fault or smear, not a panel or marking. Those bands are wrong, so the item drops to 1.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the rubric and measured apart. The line-up test measured as passed: in the four readings the asset was never picked as the one not made by Valve (picks were D, C, D, A against the asset at C, B, A, C).

M7.reason: No origin is given and the brief asks for none, so this is judged by eye. The muzzle leads in the left and below views, the gun is upright along its length in the top view, and the in-hand model stands muzzle-up with the stock down, the way the game's shotgun is held. Nothing reads as wrong.

M8.reason: The checks report no errors. The asset has 132 triangles against the median of 138 for Half-Life's props of its kind, far under twice that. Nothing visible is open, inside out or floating in the side, top, below or attack views. The dark muzzle and magazine opening are the kind of opening a player would expect.

W1.reason: In first-person.png, the asset sits where the game's own shotgun sits: the muzzle goes top-left and the stock off to bottom-right (same direction as the game's), and the orange hand grips at the pump and receiver in the same place (about 230 to 300 against the game's 710 to 780 after the panel offset of 480). Through the attack frames (shoot 0/20 to 20/20) the glove stays under the pump and the gun stays with it, and nothing parts from the hand.
